Leaving a CI job in 'reports, does not block' mode with no date by which it is required or deleted. 235 of 1,000 red runs had the required gate green. Sherpa gate B failed 214 times before its first green. All 74 master pushes on 09-02..09-06 were red, so red stopped meaning anything.

Running tests as the postgres superuser, on one connection, against a freshly created database. Missing RLS policies, REVOKE errors and pooling defects passed every test (605eb1fc10, 02feadf311, 796efcd919, #2414 and #2419 P0, 0272d9dc40).

Calling a feature done because it works against the mock client, the dev harness, /dev/login or standalone serve. Milestone 39 closures held only under the mock. The dev harness kept its own migration list (25ba762a21). Every Hearth e2e used /dev/login, which hid the fact that a newly enrolled member could never sign in (#2226).

Keeping the same list by hand in several places. Env vars live separately in the renderer, compose file, validator and settings (9 fixes in 7 days). A plan said 'register in four places' when there were six (9d66a9b3da). Vocabularies were copied per package (79a91bae01, 8d8eaccdb1).

Writing a lesson into CLAUDE.md, memory or a skill without the gate that enforces it. 22 of 32 CLAUDE.md rules are prose only. Memory is 232k words with 21% anchored. The stash rule was broken four turns after a session quoted it.

Writing long per-version design documents and reviewing them against other documents. Resource: 153k words for ~10k LOC across 7 revisions. Federation: review rounds 7-12 on one day. nexusiq: 635k words. Design review without code has no stopping point.
Closing a milestone on 'issues merged' or with 'demo not re-run' (R3 #1064; R8, R13, R20). One audit filed 189 jarvis-uat issues days after R9-R20 closed as demo done.

Gates that pass on the wrong evidence: modules-are-consumed satisfied by any __init__ import (#2348, #2400); reachability proven by grepping client.ts for a path string (#2251); an RLS gate that scanned only *.py files (d71d2cd8b2).

Turning failure into something that looks empty or successful: `?? []`, a bare except returning absent, -1 or healthy, a 404 caught into a simulated passkey success (c4331de4ee), ALL QUIET over a 503 (#2238), 42 of ~90 useLoad sites ignoring errors (#2240).

Porting prototype data and simulations verbatim: the Larsen household greeting real families (f54578e266), a nav badge hardcoded to 3 (e1dd2a5f39), a code screen that verified nothing (9e2ef45d86), release ids shown to the household (#2217).

Patching one caller of a shared seam at a time instead of fixing the class: the clock seam x7, compose env x9, 'migrate needs CREATE' x3 (5b72384e9d, ccb9fc5de2, 98663cd449), a CREATE ROLE race fixed in one package while five others carried it (f9007a5a8b).

Tuning prompts or writing workarounds before changing the mechanism. The nexusiq trade analyst took ~15 prompt commits, with the per-tool cap moved 4->2->4, before deterministic pre-fetch (af3cd63cf6). Flight routing got two workarounds before the discarded-events root cause was found (2641678a20).

Shipping a gate, hook or lane that has never been green and never been shown to fail. The Windows scheduler job was red on 7 of 7 pushes on day one. The Install Chromium step failed 20 PRs in 2 days. Three apex path hooks have been inert on Windows backslash paths since install.
Blocking merges on what a PR body says. pr_body_check led to 49 --admin merges in 9 days and was removed (#1023). It taught people to bypass gates, and the docs still claim it runs.

Advisory nudges that ask for a heavy action. The apex primer was delivered 373 times with no measured effect. Phase-gate nudges were followed 13% of the time, the discovery_dossier nudge 1 in 19, and 405 retro-debt notices went out for a debt nobody can pay.

Rapid runs of empty-body fix commits, each answering the last failure: phone auth 6 in 95 minutes, fleet.py 10 in 2 days, nexusiq launchers 8 in 5 days. The cause cannot be recovered afterwards, and each fix exposes the next defect.

Hand-maintained status, HANDOFF and tracker documents. 31% of 'ready' rows were stale within days. One stale prompt led to the CO6c slice being built three times. nexusiq's four trackers carried false checkmarks. Pulse's dossier says nothing has shipped.

Adding a second composition root (desktop, standalone, preview or CLI) without a derived parity test: #2270, #2357, eeae3969c7, #2303, #2295, and eccdf50b32, which passed only on the superuser :9999 preview.
Letting an LLM agent write to data the user authored, or own sequencing that code should own. The nexusiq scanner wiped the watchlist three times (62ec8ade82, 971fb1cd3d, 2fb1f0c8d9).
Using a dated test corpus while the code reads the wall clock. The purser-e2e walkthrough produced 101 identical reds across 29 branches when its corpus expired on 2026-09-02 (#1892).

Category-level STRIDE in place of a per-route actor matrix. It missed enrolment grants minted for another member (#2235), anonymous requests served as PULSE_MEMBER (#2229), and offboarding residue across seven issues (#2359-#2365).

Keeping two copies of the same gates in two repos. The apex-port copies drifted 88-450 changed lines from jarvis's own, and apex's hooks defer to jarvis's copies, so inside jarvis they are dead weight.
Guarding household data with pattern scanners. 21 real amounts were committed as fixtures because the scanner looked for '$' (#2527).

Re-deriving a domain rule in a new engine instead of calling its owner: income x4, ledger frontier x6-7, month arithmetic x8-10, and liquidity re-derived even though LIQUID_KINDS existed (4d4c7e8ade).
Running a scheduled-only job as the only check of the dominant defect class. fleet-smoke was red for 37 consecutive scheduled runs while every master push was green, and it gates nothing.
Letting CI spending limits lapse unnoticed. 85 runs (8.5% of failures) never started a step, and with an empty steps list they read like lint failures.
